criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Rendered throughout. Frames 1, 5, 7 and 9 are places at noon. 6 is a clock on a box against an empty sky with no Fort Davis; 8 a flat wall with a blank black-framed window and plain boxes; 2 a flat wall with a disc seal and a blank screen, ten chairs reading as five; 4 low-poly mannequins in identical strides with no shade band; 9 a foliage smear beside the dek. A game-engine look rather than a magazine spread.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One highNoon world and palette, the bus on 1, 5, 7 and 9. The stop arm motif reads only on 1 and 9. Hue alternates blue and tan on 1 to 4. One device working, the motif half.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces (c7, c16, c17, c19, figures.json, c23, c24, c33, c39 with c40, c28, c41, c42, c43, c9). The deck uses the Tribune's 10 to 3 where the SBOE minutes record 10-3-1 (c2). 'Declined, 5' is a touch firmer than c19's 'did not pursue an agreement'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A reader learns who acted, which districts piloted and declined, Houston's withheld contract, and a real step on 9. The deck never dates the board's vote, so the order the story depends on is untold, and Alpha is explained only on 6.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays the count, 3 turns, 9 closes on an action. 6 and 7 could merge. 8 pays 2's test gains six frames later.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Good Texas specifics. Machine disclaimers on 4 and 5. Attribution in 2's headline and 'the Tribune reports' three times. The caption's first line does not hook until line 2.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Topic clean in the window. No. 38 was TEA on a campus with a school object, and no. 41 yesterday carried a yellow vehicle hero on a Texas road.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frames 6, 8 and 2 as real places (a Fort Davis entry with the rimrock on a horizon, a classroom without the blank black window, a hearing room at three quarters so ten chairs read as ten), and give frame 2's dek a clause on what Alpha's model is and that the board's no came before the September 2025 emails.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A clock on a box against empty sky, no ground, no Fort Davis.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the camera so a horizon sits on the lower third with the rimrock behind the entry, the clock under the walkway's noon shade.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A blank black-framed window as a dead zone; plain boxes; no room.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Delete the black window frame and pull back to show a classroom with a real window off frame throwing shadows across the oak.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat wall, disc seal, blank screen; ten chairs read as five.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A three-quarter angle from the gallery so the ten separate and the aisle opens.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Side-on mannequins in identical strides; no shade band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push the party into depth beyond a black band of walkway shade, turned away.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A translucent foliage smear beside the dek's end, x 1290 to 1450, y 740 to 840 of the 1600 px view.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Cull or re-seed the oak so the crown ends cleanly behind the dek's right edge.
